name: Cream Tax
gmNotes:
Tutorial Side Mission for Mission Trackers, guarded movement, stealth/fail-forward play, domestic offerings, and the distinction between physical payment and Grace. It covers only the cream portion of Coinin's bargain and may be completed before or after Milk and Feathers or Iron and Wax. Coinin conceals the true destination of the cream without making a false assertion.

The village watch has been strengthened because horseshoes have recently vanished from doors and from the smithy. The beekeeper's apprentice stole them to protect the workshop from the Fey, but do not reveal the culprit merely because the GM knows it. If the player points out the coincidence between the missing horseshoes and the cache in Buaic's workshop, the apprentice will confess when confronted.
briefing: Coinin wants the ten measures of cream promised for his silence. Cross the watched gate after dark, gather the offerings from thresholds inside Trí Mhuilinn, and leave without turning the village against you.
objective: Enter the guarded village, collect ten measures of cream, and deliver them to Coinin.
debriefing: Coinin has his ten measures of cream, and Trí Mhuilinn sleeps on—more or less. The milk and honey remain due unless those errands were completed already.

storyBeats.title: Coinin's Tax
storyBeats.events: In the Hollow Tree, Coinin explains that households inside the palisade leave cream outside for household spirits. Normally he collects these offerings at night, but the village has been guarded since yesterday for reasons he claims not to know. He wants ten measures collected before morning and returned to him. Meabh recognises a supply route; the player is likely to see neighbours' offerings being taken. A concealed Fairy Door in the lower chamber opens into the western woods, outside the palisade.
storyBeats.objective: Learn where the cream is and why Coinin cannot collect it himself.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Keep Coinin literally truthful but strategically incomplete. He does not claim he can consume the cream and does not reveal the Takeling/clone supply chain. Use the existing Grace and Bargain rules to explain that the cream discharges one obligation; do not invent a numeric Grace reward. Let the team approach by the surface path or use Coinin's Fairy Door to the Hidden Fairy Door in the western woods. The portal shortens travel but does not bypass Tri Mhuilinn Gate or the watched interior.

storyBeats.title: The Watched Gate
storyBeats.events: Recently, someone stole horseshoes from village doors and the smithy. One watchman now guards Tri Mhuilinn Gate while another patrols Inside Palisade. The team must choose whether to sneak, bluff, use a familiar route, create a distraction, or explain themselves.
storyBeats.objective: Pass Tri Mhuilinn Gate without alarming the watch.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Use Village Guard - Prototype 01 at the gate and Village Guard - Prototype 02 for the patrol inside. Make the guards alert rather than murderous. A failed approach may cost Cover or Nerve, create suspicion, require a favour, split the route, or force a new plan. It must not prevent collection or turn the Mission into combat.

storyBeats.title: Bowls at the Thresholds
storyBeats.events: Inside the palisade, bowls, pots, and covered vessels sit at selected household thresholds. Some are easy to reach; others lie near dogs, wakeful families, creaking doors, iron charms, or the patrol's route. Update the cream Mission Tracker immediately as measures are secured.
storyBeats.objective: Gather ten measures of cream from sleeping households.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Offer several small problems and let player choices determine which houses they risk. Do not roll for every vessel. Use checks only where discovery or loss is meaningfully at stake. On failure, spill or lose some progress, attract attention, create a social consequence, or demand a different route; always leave enough opportunities to reach the target. Once the cream is collected, do not require the team to pass through the guarded gate again. The palisade is a defensive boundary, not a prison: from inside, let them find a climbable section, exploit a gap or weak point, use nearby structures or objects, or devise another plausible way out. Require a check only if active pursuit, a hazardous method, or protecting the cream makes the exit meaningfully uncertain. Existing suspicion or pursuit does not disappear when they cross the wall.

storyBeats.title: The Tax Collected
storyBeats.events: The team returns to Coinin's Hollow Tree with ten measures of cream, by the woodland Fairy Door or another viable route. He checks the quantity with professional exactness and acknowledges that the cream portion of the promised payment has been delivered. Milk and honey remain due unless their Missions were completed first.
storyBeats.objective: Deliver the cream and record that part of the bargain as fulfilled.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Keep the cream tracker at target as historical Mission-object progress once delivery is complete; it records the objective, not carried inventory. In Coinin's Silence, resolve only the accepting party's cream obligation. Leave the milk, honey, and Coinin's nondisclosure obligations as they stand.

description: Cream offerings wait outside sleeping homes within Trí Mhuilinn's palisade, but recent thefts have put two watchmen on duty. Collecting Coinin's peculiar tax will teach what the Good People regard as payment—and what humans call stealing.
completionEffects: Under Coinin's Silence, mark only the accepting party's cream obligation resolved. Do not change the milk or honey obligations. Coinin's promise not to tell Morrigan remains active, so the Bargain itself remains active. Do not advance the moon phase.
